data.name: Stronghold Defender
data.detailed_description:
Hold the walls. Harvest the field. Crush the horde.

Stronghold Defender is a castle defense game where standing your ground means thinking fast and fighting harder. Waves of ruthless creatures march toward your gates  and the only thing between them and total destruction is you.

Gather resources scattered across the battlefield, recruit defenders to man your towers, and activate powerful abilities when the tide turns against you. Every wave hits harder. Every second counts.

Recruit & Command: Fill your towers with Archers, Catapults, Mages, and Elite units each with unique strengths. Choose the right defenders for the right moment, and upgrade them to unleash their full potential.

Scavenge to Survive: Resources don't come to you. Collect wood, stone, gold, and more from the battlefield to fund your army. Risk and reward go hand in hand  the best loot is always closest to the enemy.

Unleash Devastating Abilities: When the hordes become overwhelming, activate special powers to turn the battlefield into chaos. Time them right, and watch entire waves crumble.

Grow Stronger with Every Battle: Invest in a deep skill tree to permanently enhance your castle, units, and abilities. Build your strategy your way  no two commanders play alike.

Key Features: 
Wave-based castle defense with intense, escalating combat 
Multiple tower and unit types: Archers, Catapults, Mages, and more 
Real-time resource gathering on the battlefield 
Powerful special abilities to turn the tide 
Expansive skill tree for long-term progression 
Upgrade your towers and units to face ever-deadlier threats
